messages_orig.content: foot blisters from new shoes commonly occur due to friction on the skin. to help prevent them, consider gradually breaking in your shoes, wearing socks that reduce friction, or using padding like moleskin on high-friction areas. if a blister does form, keep it clean and covered to prevent infection. if it worsens or shows signs of infection, medical advice may be necessary.
should i use moleskin or different socks, i have no diabetes or circulation issues
